display.purpose: The name only, once per page, followed by the growth-ring mark. Optical sizing on.

lede.purpose: The one-line self-description (ink, balanced wrap) and the current-role line (ink-soft).

title.purpose: Section headings. Body size; weight 600 alone makes them headings.

body.purpose: Project notes and running text, pretty wrap, about 65 characters to the line.

body-strong.purpose: Project names in the work list, linked (moss) or not (ink).

year.purpose: The work-list year column in tabular lining numerals; 0.9375rem below 480px.

label.purpose: The colophon; its second line is italic.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: Link underline colour from moss-soft to solid moss on hover; also the arrow's opacity change.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The one expressive curve: the outbound arrow nudge (200ms) and the mark's year-arc draw.

motion.name: mark-draw
motion.purpose: The mark's moss arc draws on once at load; skipped under prefers-reduced-motion. Never loops.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Work rows stack year over name; repeated years are removed.

themes.switch: prefers-color-scheme on :root; every colour token has a -dark pair

narrative.overview:
The page is a title page. It is set in one serif on warm paper and signed with one small emblem, the way an old printer set a device beside the imprint. The type does all the work: the name, one line about the person, the current role, a dated list of work newest first, three links out, and a short colophon. Everything reads at once in a single left-aligned column, and nothing is hidden behind a click, a hover or an animation.

The only art is the mark: a hairline growth-ring emblem about the height of a capital, set just after the name. Its inner rings are fixed, slightly eccentric circles in faded ink. Its outer ring is the current year. A dotted ring shows the whole year and a moss arc runs from twelve o'clock as far round as the calendar has come. The favicon repeats the mark on a paper tile. The mark is a quiet signature, not an illustration, and it stays that small.

The density is low and the tone is calm and warm. Paper and brown ink carry every neutral; moss green is the one accent. An earlier version with a large illustrated tree cross-section was rejected by the owner as "too child like". Art stays at the scale of a mark beside the name.
keyCharacteristics: One centred column, 38rem wide including its gutters, with left-aligned text and the name about 18vh from the top.
One typeface (Source Serif 4, optical sizing on) at weights 400, 500 and 600, plus italic for the colophon note. No uppercase, no letter-spaced labels.
Moss is the only accent. Every other colour is warm paper or brown ink, in a light and a dark theme that follow the system setting.
Flat paper: no boxes, cards, shadows or images. The only line on the page is the colophon's hairline rule.
The mark is the only art. It draws its year arc once on load and holds still.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Moss marks only what is live: a link, focus, selection, and the year still growing on the mark. Nothing decorative is green.

rules.name: The Brown-Not-Grey Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is a warm brown. The ground is paper or charred walnut, never grey, pure white or pure black.

rules.name: The Pair Rule
rules.body: Every colour token has a light and a dark value, switched by `prefers-color-scheme` on `:root`. A new colour ships as a pair or not at all.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Everything is Source Serif 4. Hierarchy comes from size, weight (400, 500, 600) and colour strength. Do not add a second face, a mono, uppercase or tracking.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Any column of years or figures uses tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Everything lives in the one 38rem column, left-aligned. No sidebars, no split heroes, no full-bleed bands.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow and nothing sits in a box. If something needs separating, use space first, then a single `rule` hairline.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every drawn line is a hairline in ink or moss. Nothing drawn is filled, heavy or coloured beyond the palette.

dos: **Do** set every word in Source Serif 4 and build hierarchy from size, weight (400/500/600) and the three ink strengths.
**Do** keep moss for links, focus, selection and the growing year only (The One Green Rule).
**Do** keep all content in the single 38rem column with the fluid gutter.
**Do** give every new colour a light and a dark value, both warm.
**Do** keep text at `ink-faint` strength or stronger (4.8:1 on paper, 5.1:1 on the dark ground).
**Do** use tabular lining numerals for any column of years or figures.
donts: **Don't** add illustration: no tree cross-section, pins, core lines, bark or wood textures. The illustrated version was rejected as "too child like".
**Don't** grow the mark past about 1em beside the name, or repeat it as decoration elsewhere on the page.
**Don't** add boxes, cards, shadows, background fills or images.
**Don't** add a second typeface, uppercase labels, eyebrows or letter-spacing.
**Don't** use grey, pure white or pure black anywhere.
**Don't** gate or delay any text behind motion, hover or discovery.
